decisions.reason: The modular extensions are a multi-model line built on the firm's core waste-to-energy plant business, so sunk engineering effort and core relevance favor persisting, even though the product was absent from the website in 2020-2021.

As a publicly presented flagship with heavy sunk investment, the waste-oil-to-energy plant's weak visibility can be blamed on long industrial sales cycles and pandemic-related delays, so management would continue.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is central to the firm's announced sustainability direction and public commitment, so disappointing results would be read as temporary market-development issues rather than grounds to exit.
